descriptionHtml:
ONIKUMA G32 Wired Gaming Keyboard Rainbow Backlight (104 Keys Full-Size Layout / Mechanical Tactile Feel / Integrated Wrist Rest / 19-Key Anti-Ghosting / Dynamic Rainbow Backlight / Spill-Resistant Design / 1-Year Official Agent Warranty)

Upgrade your gaming setup with the ONIKUMA G32 Wired Gaming Keyboard, available at Turbo Computer Egypt with a 1-Year Official Agent Warranty (ضمان سنة من الوكيل). Featuring a full 104-key layout with an integrated ergonomic wrist rest, tactile mechanical-feel membrane keys, vibrant Rainbow LED backlighting, matte anti-fingerprint keycaps, and 19-key anti-ghosting rollover, the G32 is built for smooth, reliable gaming performance and everyday durability.
